name: LAXASFIT Smart Watch 7+1 Set Bluetooth Call Message Reminder Health Monitor Multiple Bands Switchable Smartwatch For IOS/Android
description:
Specification



1. Watch size: 48.2 mm

2. Watch color: black, white

3. Screen size: 1.52 inches

4. Battery: 160mAh lithium-ion battery, longer battery life

5. System: Support Android5.0 and IOS9.0 and above.

6.Language:English(defaut),French,Spanish,Polish,Portuguese,Italian,German,Turkish,Russian,Arabic,Hungarian,Farsi, Filipino, Malay, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Thai,Hebrew, Swedish, Finnish



Features



1.7 different styles of watch bands to mix and match as you wish

2. Notification: Synchronized notification of incoming calls from your phone's notification center, incoming call alert.

3. Calls: make and receive calls after connecting with Bluetooth of smartphone.

4. Heart Rate Detection / Blood Pressure Detection / Blood Oxygen Detection.

5. Sleep monitoring: objectively and scientifically record and analyze your sleep status.

6. Steps: step counting, calorie, distance monitoring.

7. sports mode. (running, hiking, soccer)

8. bluetooth music player: cell phone music player with remote control.

9. bluetooth camera: cell phone remote control to take pictures.

10. find cell phone: anti-lost, call cell phone or watch.

11. Customized watch face: You can upload your own photo to the watch as dial. 11.

12. Sedentary Reminder: Set time to remind you to do exercise and change unhealthy lifestyle.

13. Other functions: alarm clock, calculator, smart voice, phonebook, weather.



packing list



Smartwatch *1

Charging Cable *1

User Manual *1

Box *1

Band *7
